reproducibility_gaps: Stage-3 assessment is static only; no dependency installation, training, inference or evaluation was executed.
requirements.txt names the runtime dependencies but provides no dependency version pins, and setup.py does not constrain the Python/runtime compatibility surface.
The steady cavity workflow references ../../data/cavity_steady/, which is not bundled at the pinned repository snapshot and was not acquired in Stage 3.
The Navier–Stokes workflow references ../../data/Navier_Stokes/ns_V1e-3_N5000_T50.mat, which is not bundled at the pinned repository snapshot and was not acquired in Stage 3.
Hardware and accelerator requirements are not specified; the example scripts contain GPU-selection/memory-growth logic but do not establish a reproducible hardware target.
README comparative-performance statements and examples/results.png were not independently reproduced or linked to a statically verified run lineage.
No trained-model checkpoint artifacts are bundled at the pinned snapshot.
notes: R2 reflects pinned MIT-licensed source, explicit installation paths, an environment manifest, three identifiable training entrypoints, documented architecture/hyperparameters/seeds, and a fully code-generated nonlinear-1D data workflow.
R3 is withheld because two of the three assessed workflows depend on external data absent from the pinned repository, while dependency versions and result/checkpoint lineage remain incomplete.
